topic.topic: London taxi drivers and the hippocampus
topic.angle: The Knowledge and a bigger back hippocampus

card.title: Black cab drivers and the hippocampus

body.claim: In London's black cab drivers, the posterior part of the hippocampus is larger than in the general public.
body.why: To get a licence, they must pass a strict test known as The Knowledge, which means learning the locations of a large number of places and the fastest routes between them. A study found a positive correlation between time served as a driver and the increase in volume of this part. The total volume of the hippocampus was unchanged, as the increase was made at the expense of the anterior part.

probes.question: What is the strict test London's black cab drivers must pass called?
True or false: in the study, the total volume of the hippocampus was unchanged in these drivers.
